Show the countdown in the status bar

Samsung One UI only shows Live notifications (the coloured chip next to the clock, and the Now Bar) for its own apps and approved partners. Other apps need a developer option:

1. Settings → About phone → Software information → tap “Build number” 7 times to unlock Developer options.
2. Settings → Developer options → turn on “Live notifications for all apps”.
3. Come back here and tap “Test countdown now”.

On other phones, turn on “Live updates” in this app's notification settings.
